packages.behavior_affected: The package adds the server's chat-to-agent feature support: a chat brief mandate/offer, generated streamed progress/result types, and generated request/response typing for user and admin endpoints. Extension source imports agents catalog/context/transport APIs but has no call to either from-chat endpoint, no handling of those stream events, and no agent-studio UI. Its MANDATE_KEYS references resolve fixed existing keys. These additive package APIs therefore do not evidence changed extension behavior.

No org-chart UI or org_chart edge writer was found in extension source.

acceptance.extension_source_or_entrypoint_delta: The frozen delta artifact reports zero changed extension product source/entrypoint paths. This audit found no activated or newly consumed package behavior requiring an existing extension case.
acceptance.decision: The three package versions contain documented upstream changes, but the inspected behavior does not map to changed or newly exposed extension behavior. EXT-F-1007-C30 remains relevant to existing Source filing, while it does not cover org-chart membership. This source/inventory audit does not establish runtime acceptance for 0.2.258 or extend the frozen 0.2.244 acceptance.
